name: TigerConnect
description: Workflows covering TigerConnect's clinical messaging REST API operations for users, groups, organizations, messages, roster, and metadata, organized by resource category.

aa.name: createOrUpdateUser
aa.description: This endpoint lets users generate or update users.

body.description: Request body for Create Or Update User.

unique_id.description: The user's unique identifier. If there's already a user with this unique_id in the caller's organization, it will be updated. If there's a user with the same unique_id but it doesn't belong to the caller's organization, an error will be returned. And, if there's no users with that unique_id, the user will be created.

emails.description: A list of the user's email addresses

phones.description: A list of the user's phone numbers

display_name.description: The user's display name (if not provided it's built using first_name and/or last_name)

distinguished_name.description: The user's unique identifier used in conjunction with optional header TT-X-Organization-Key for external authentication

ab.name: getUser
ab.description: This endpoint retrieves user information associated with the user addressed by [Addressing Users and Groups](https://developer.tigertext.com/docs/messaging-users-and-groups), if found. This endpoint provides the usual [Request and Response Formats](https://developer.tigertext.com/docs/request-and-response-formats).

user.description: User addressed by [Addressing Users and Groups](https://developer.tigertext.com/docs/messaging-users-and-groups#addressing-users), if found.

ac.name: lookupUser
ac.description: This endpoint retrieves the basic details of user addressed by user address.  User address is interpreted using address encoding. If the user does not exist, it will respond with a 'not found' status.

user.description: The user email, username, phone number or user token

ad.name: addUserToOrganization
ad.description: This endpoint adds a user to an organization. The user can be addressed by user address. User address is interpreted using address encoding.

user.description: The user email, username, phone number or user token

body.description: Request body for Add User To Organization.

organization_key.description: The key for the organization to which the user will be added

ae.name: removeUserFromOrganization
ae.description: This endpoint removes a user to an organization. The user can be addressed by user address. User address is interpreted using address encoding.

user.description: The user email, username, phone number or user token

organization.description: The key for the organization to which the user will be removed

af.name: getUserRoles
af.description: Retrieves the roles assigned to a particular user within an organization

organization.description: The key for the organization to which the user will be removed

a10.name: assignUserRole
a10.description: Assigns a specific role to a particular user within an organization

organization.description: The key for the organization to which the user will be removed

role.description: The associated role - Customer, Help Desk, Admin or Reporting

a11.name: removeUserRole
a11.description: Removes an assigned role from a particular user within an organization

organization.description: The key for the organization to which the user will be removed

role.description: The associated role - Customer, Help Desk, Admin or Reporting

members.description: The members to add to the group encoded using address encoding (Note: The caller is auto-added)

avatar.description: (optional): Binary data to use for the group's avatar

is_public.description: (optional): A boolean value of whether it is public / private group.

replay_history.description: (optional): A boolean value indicating if, when a new member is added to the group, it should get the messages sent to the group before that.

a13.name: getGroup
a13.description: Get information about a group using its group token.

a14.name: updateGroup
a14.description: Update information about a group using its group token.

avatar.description: (optional): Binary data to use for the group's avatar

a15.name: deleteGroup
a15.description: Delete a group. If the group has already been deleted, no error is reported.

body.description: Request body for Add Group Members.

members.description: list of the new members on the group encoded using address encoding (users already in the group are ignored). When sending a Json object, you can send the list directly instead of an object with the members property. There is a maximum group size limit. Default for public group is 5000 members. Default for private group is 100 members. Both are configurable.

body.description: Request body for Remove Group Members.

members.description: list of the new members on the group encoded using address encoding (users already in the group are ignored). When sending a Json object, you can send the list directly instead of an object with the members property. There is a maximum group size limit. Default for public group is 5000 members. Default for private group is 100 members. Both are configurable.

a18.name: createOrganization
a18.description: This endpoint creates new TigerText organizations.

ttl.description: The number of minutes for message time to live.

billing.description: Should always be set to active.

a19.name: getOrganization
a19.description: This endpoint gets information about an existing TigerText organization.

welcome_email_settings.example: {"from":"TigerText Admin","subject":"You have been invited to join Charles Test Org on TigerText for secure HIPAA-compliant messaging","optional_header":"","optional_message":"","optional_name":""}

a1a.name: updateOrganization
a1a.description: This endpoint updates existing TigerText organizations.

ttl.description: The number of minutes for message time to live.

a1b.name: deleteOrganization
a1b.description: This endpoint deletes an existing TigerText organization.

a1c.name: createSecurityGroups
a1c.description: The endpoint creates a new custom directory for an organization.  Security groups are portrayed in the Web Admin as Custom Directories.

organization.description: The key for the organization to which the user will be removed

body.description: Request body for Create Security Groups.

security_groups.description: A list of security groups to be created

response_format.description: The expected response format.  If set to message, the full message will be included in the response.  Otherwise default response has no body just regular headers.

sender_organization.description: The organization token for the sender. If not present, will default to the organization key of the sender.

recipient.description: Recipient is either a user or a group, encoded using address encoding.

recipient_organization.description: For P2P messages, the organization token for the recipient. If not present, will default to the organization key of the sender.

ttl.description: An integer value with the number of minutes until the message expires. -1 indicates no expiration and it's the default value

dor.description: A boolean value indicating that the message should be deleted on read.

data.description: A group of user-defined datum elements that will be associated with the message. Depending on the request format this field will be parsed differently:

a1e.name: getMessage
a1e.description: This endpoint retrieves message information associated with the :message-id, if found. It provides the usual response formats.

a1f.name: deleteMessage
a1f.description: This endpoint deletes the message. If the message was already deleted, no error is reported.

a20.name: getMessageAttachment
a20.description: This endpoint retrieves the attachment from the message.

accept.description: on fetching an attachment, we may have optional 'Accept' header which valid values are:  application/pdf application/msword, application/msexcel, application/mspowerpoint, image/tt-zip, image/tt-thumbnail-jpg

a21.name: setMessageStatus
a21.description: This endpoint lets users set the status of messages.

body.description: Request body for Set Message Status.

delivered.description: A list of message ids to set status to Delivered

read.description: A list of message ids to set status to Read

a22.name: getMessageStatus
a22.description: This endpoint retrieves message recipient status information associated.

a23.name: addRosterEntry
a23.description: Add users or lists to their roster.

body.description: Request body for Add Roster Entry.

entity.description: The list token or the friend address (encoded using address encoding)

type.description: Any of the following options: "tigertext:entity:account" (default): For users "tigertext:entity:list": For distribution lists

a24.name: getRoster
a24.description: Get the recent conversation list for a user. As new messages are sent and received, the roster is updated with those conversations.

a25.name: removeRosterEntry
a25.description: Remove a conversation from the recent conversation list. For conversations that are with another User, all messages are deleted. For conversations with a group, the User leaves the group and is no longer receives subsequent group messages.

entity.description: entity addressed by address encoding from the user's roster. If the entity was already removed, no error is reported.

a26.name: setEntityMetadata
a26.description: Adds metadata for a user or Group based on address encoding.  The POSTed JSON object or the POST body itself will be parsed as lists of {Key, Value} pairs and just stored as the entity metadata, thus replacing any existing metadata.

body.description: Request body for Set Entity Metadata.

a27.name: getEntityMetadata
a27.description: Get the metadata for a User or Group based on address encoding.

entity.description: User or group based on address encoding.

a28.name: search
a28.description: Search entities in the system according to the provided parameters

type.description: A list of the types of entities to return from search, leaving blank will return all types.  Possible type values: "account" "distribution_list" "group" "public_group".  For example ["account", "group"]

directory.description: A list of the organization IDs to restrict the results

display_name.description: Filtering field for partial match on account, group or distribution list display name

department.description: Filtering field for partial match on account department

title.description: Filtering field for partial match on account title
